name: Obits 1
description: Obituaries displayed in a grid with the ability to change the number of obituaries displayed and the number of columns. Text is overlayed on top of the image.

name: Obits 2
description: Similar to Obits 1, obituaries are displayed in a grid with the ability to change the number of obituaries displayed and the number of columns. Text is shown below the image.

name: Obits 6
description: Each obituary is displayed as it's own card on a sliding grid.

name: Obits Infinite Slider
description: Moving carousel showing the most recent 12 obituaries. The carousel pauses when hovered and displays the name and date of death for that obituary. Two rows can be enabled to show the most recent 24.

name: Obit Hover Cards
description: Obituaries displayed as hoverable cards with additional information revealed on hover.

name: Obit Slider
description: A slider widget for displaying a single obituary at a time in a horizontal carousel.

name: Obit Page
description: Classic widget for the obit page with the cards stacked vertically. "Simple Obit Card" option hides the obituary preview and creates smaller cards in a 2 column grid.

name: V2 Obit Page
description: Search-and-filter obit page with cards in a responsive grid (3 columns on desktop, 2 on tablet, 1 on mobile) plus pagination. Visitors can search by name, filter by Veterans Only or obituary text, narrow by date range, and filter by location when enabled. Configurable options include circle or black-and-white images, custom button labels, and hiding dates or branch.

name: Obituary Search
description: Search widget for finding obituaries by name. Redirects to the obituary page with search results.

name: Email Subscribe
description: 2 Widgets in 1: Obituary Notifications Subscribe Form and Grief Steps Subscribe Form
useCase: Footer, Obituary page, Obituary Notifications page
notes: Multi-location can be enabled. You can also collect the person's First & Last name if the funeral home requests it.

description: Version 1 of our Send Flowers widget on the send flowers page.

widgetSettings.smsDesc:
Our website may offer the option to receive service updates, appointment information, or other communications by SMS text message. These messages are delivered through a third-party service provider. By choosing to receive text messages, you acknowledge that your mobile number and related data will be shared with that provider solely for the purpose of sending SMS communications.


Your Consent

Text messages are sent only to individuals who have opted in. You may opt out at any time by replying STOP to any message you receive. Once you opt out, you will stop receiving SMS communications unless you choose to opt in again.


Message & Data Rates

Message and data rates may apply based on your mobile carrier and plan. The funeral home is not responsible for any fees charged by your carrier.


Information Handling

The third-party provider may collect your mobile number, message preferences, and any information you submit as part of your SMS participation. This information is used only to deliver the messages you request and to support the SMS program. We do not sell or share your mobile number or SMS participation details with other third parties for marketing purposes.


Third-Party Practices

Because the SMS program is operated by an external provider, their privacy practices and terms may also apply. We encourage you to review their policies if you have questions about how your information is managed.

By opting in to receive SMS text messages from our website, you agree to the following terms. SMS communications offered through this site are delivered by a third-party service provider. Your participation in the SMS program is voluntary.


Use of the Service

By providing your mobile number and opting in, you authorize our third-party provider to send you text messages related to services, scheduling, updates, or other information you have requested. Message frequency may vary.


User Responsibilities

You agree that the mobile number you provide is your own and that you are authorized to receive messages at that number. You are responsible for ensuring your contact information remains accurate.


Opt-Out

You may opt out of SMS messaging at any time by replying STOP to any message. After opting out, you will no longer receive text messages unless you opt in again.


Third-Party Operation

Because SMS services are facilitated by an external provider, their terms and policies may also apply in addition to these Terms of Use. We are not responsible for delays, failures, or errors in message delivery caused by the third-party provider or your mobile carrier.


Message & Data Rates

Standard message and data rates may apply. You are solely responsible for any fees charged by your mobile carrier.


No Warranties

SMS messaging is provided on an “as available” basis. We do not guarantee message delivery times or uninterrupted access to the SMS service.
